adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review reopened the handoff packet, primary XML/PDF, OA package, supplementary PDF/text, locator index, and linked APD6/DBAASP/DRAMP database snapshots. Table 1 activity rows are now source-parsed, Table 2/3 P-values are retained as statistics rather than activity endpoints, linked DBAASP/dbAMP/DRAMP activity annotations are reconciled to primary rows where supported, and the APD6 computed annotation remains database_only_no_primary_source as a caution. No blocking or major rework target remains open. HepG2 toxicity wording was tightened to preserve the methods/caption concentration-range mismatch as a nonblocking caution.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay rows and dbAMP aggregate entries are source-reconciled to Tables 1/2. DRAMP qualitative S. cerevisiae activity is source-supported without exact DRAMP values. APD6 computed similarity/property prose is preserved as database_only_no_primary_source rather than promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 1/2/3 IC50 rows now have endpoint, raw value, unit, entity, target organism/strain when locally available, assay context, statistics, and locators. P-values are stored as statistics only. HepG2 toxicity is retained as qualitative supplementary evidence because exact curve values are not tabulated locally.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Kv1.2/Kv1.6 block is direct voltage-clamp evidence; yeast potassium-homeostasis findings are bounded to tolerance/context evidence and not overclaimed as the direct antifungal target.

caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6 similarity/property prose is database-generated and is not present as a primary-source assay row; it remains database_only_no_primary_source.
DRAMP states active against S. cerevisiae without exact value fields; primary Table 1/Table 2 support activity and exact source IC50 values are carried in activity records.

Supplementary Figure S4 and Methods support no HepG2 viability reduction up to about 25 μM, but the local sources differ slightly on the maximum concentration (23.5 μM in Methods, 24.3 μM in the supplement caption/axis) and exact curve point values are figure-only rather than tabulated.
The original rework ticket is closed after source review, but database-only/APD and non-tabulated supplement limitations prevent accepted_clean.
